launch_conditions: Launcher must retain evidence that the current Astra baseline phase has fully exited and no other source-measurement model phase is active before starting this pilot. This review does not certify that live condition.

Require five unique native sessions/private directories and global mailbox UUIDs, successful expected CLI/model/effort/exits, no protocol errors and common five-window native timestamp overlap.
Any original failure or unmet overlap/identity/literal condition holds readiness without retry.
limits: Raw rendering must_include scoring alone can accept extra text; the separately registered exact byte comparison is mandatory.
Native timestamps demonstrate overlapping short session windows only. They cannot establish simultaneous provider execution, performance, long-context reliability or general service limits.

The conservative freeze verifies current file bytes and observed/static imported closure. It is not an audit of every frozen source file or of untracked dependency trees. No new untracked code or source edits are authorised between freeze and execution.
No source-fidelity, source-savings or production-loop qualification follows from this pilot. Prior failed records and held cohorts remain unchanged.
